title: The Throat will close in fifty-two days
desc: The Company's announcement: the throat-watch has recorded the onset of a closing phase. The Company withdraws; the indentured stay, their contracts held in trust.
knowers: Before the story (from the first scene)
Before the story (from the first scene)

title: The Tally's root opens only to the Director's seal and the Comptroller's key together
desc: The root, behind three doors in the Counting House vault, holds the rules. Two keys together can rewrite the Tally's book; nothing can switch it off.
knowers: Before the story (from the first scene)
Before the story (from the first scene)

title: The Company is moving the aft stores' fuel into the Covenant
desc: Haulers paid in hard Concord credit to carry fuel cassettes from the aft stores to the Covenant's hold. The Company says it leaves three hundred years of fuel for the Wick.
knowers: Before the story (from the first scene)

title: The Count will Call the ten thousand deepest accounts into the Cold
desc: Vosk at the Hook: the Wick will fail before year's end. The ten thousand deepest accounts will be released from the Tally's charge and sent into the Cold Wards. Lists posted in thirty days.
knowers: Before the story (from the first scene)
Before the story (from the first scene)

title: Agathe Hask's balance carries an error of 2,145 credits
desc: An inheritance surcharge keyed against her whole balance since 299 AC and then compounded. Corrected, she is above the Calling line.

title: The Caul Account has no holder and was authorised by a key the Tally does not know
desc: First root entry, forty-ninth day of the Closing, 2387: creditor CAUL, all balances assigned in full, account holder NONE. Not the Founders' paired mark.
knowers: Before the story (from the first scene)

title: The Mercy Bell left the Sabra system before the Closing
desc: Fen's family bought it at a wreck auction at Tannet, from an unidentified hulk, thirty years after the Closing. How it came out is unknown.
knowers: Before the story (from the first scene)
Before the story (from the first scene)

title: Hold 2 of the Good Title draws cryo-level power
desc: Sealed, certified 'agricultural stock'. The draw is larger than bridge, galley and quarters together: a deep-cold draw.
knowers: Before the story (from the first scene)
